title: Start here: ask the authority map before writing banking code
summary: FederationBank is intentionally a system of disagreeing authorities. Use the sphere to identify which component owns a fact, then inspect the current package before changing code. A convenient object graph is not the architecture.
invariants: Channels request; backend authorities decide and execute.
Do not merge Account, Payments, Ledger, physical cash custody, Staff Authority, or Merchant Banking merely because one demo flow crosses them.
A newer package in the workspace overrides an older sphere observation; inspect the package and revise the sphere rather than coding from stale memory.
Fixtures are test policy/data, not real regulatory facts.
procedure: Search the corpus for the operation or invariant, for example `gopher --profile federationbank search "physical cash" --sphere federationbank`.
Open the most relevant article with `gopher --profile federationbank open <article-id>`.
Before editing implementation, inspect the actual current ZIP/member with Gopher archive services; source/package evidence beats recollection.
After a material architectural correction, revise the smallest responsible sphere object and attach provenance.

provenance.claim: Core authority split and channel/backend rule.
